document.cue: Describe a website that you often visit.

text: I'd like to talk about an online dictionary website that I visit almost every day. I found it about three years ago, when my English teacher recommended it to the whole class, and since then I've kept it in my browser's favourites. It's very simple and has a clean white design, which I like.

I mainly use it to check the meaning and pronunciation of new words. When I read an article or watch a series in English, I write down unfamiliar words and look them up there in the evening. What I particularly like is that each word has several example sentences, so I can see how it's used in real life. There's also a feature that lets you listen to both British and American pronunciation, which helps me a lot. Besides, I use the translation tool when I'm writing emails, although I always double-check the result, because machine translation isn't perfect.

I like this website because it's reliable and free, and it saves me a lot of time. Before, I used to carry a heavy paper dictionary, and finding a word took several minutes. Now it takes a few seconds. Having said that, I try not to rely on it too much, because I want to guess the meaning from context first. All in all, it's one of the most useful tools I have for learning English, and I'd definitely recommend it to other students.
